evaluator: early-bed-fit-1: E = D + Q/ab - r*max(0, T_elapsed - Tk), exact hinge, repair half-time h on fraction times
row_order: draws in the order of the source unit's draws.csv.gz (4 chains x 1000), one joint row per draw
label: Trial-count fit (research)
endpoint: severe acute mucositis (maximum grade >= 3, or confluent), arm-level counts pooled across grading scales, observation windows and evaluable, as-treated or completer populations; 22 randomized trial families (51 arms, 6042 evaluable patients); 2 of 22 families met the adequate post-RT ascertainment rule
model: logit p = eta_trial + kappa * (E - E_ref) + gamma * chemo + arm effect; E = D + Q/ab - r * max(0, T_elapsed - Tk), Q with incomplete repair
margin_meaning: +5 is a numerical margin on this model's BED scale; its clinical risk meaning is not established
chemotherapy_term: one pooled coarse indicator (greater or added planned chemotherapy exposure); not a treatment-specific causal effect; not used by the calculator
status: research scenario; Fowler 2003 is the app default. Validation: better held-out log score across 22 trial families (+0.28 per family); HYPNO depends on its chemotherapy assumption; ELAN-RT (frail, split course) favored the Fowler-parameter benchmark.
